svg.title: Chunk meshing
svg.desc: generateChunkMesh() — hidden faces are skipped, and every vertex gets a baked occlusion factor that the fragment shader darkens with.
svg.text: generateChunkMesh() — hidden faces are skipped, and every vertex gets a baked occlusion factor that the fragment shader darkens with.
A face is emitted only if its neighbour is Air (or another transparent block).

g.text: in-game: 121 chunks → 91 558 quads · meshed in ~38 ms

svg.text: Each corner looks at 3 blocks: two sides and the diagonal.
